definitions.substitution: Literal p and f both become the stated replacement, everywhere in all words.
definitions.labels: P/F membership and paragraph position are fixed from the original text, before substitution.
definitions.removal: Same four-set Shapley removal attribution as run.py; gaps close after removing words.
definitions.fixed: Original token positions and windows; every type has unit credit divided among its occurrences. Per-token means divide by token-window exposure.
definitions.comparison: Compare non-P/F words after the first word of opening lines with non-P/F words on subsequent lines. All opening lines are included.
definitions.rolling: End-of-line minus pre-line trailing diversity; arriving words receive new-type gain minus departing-type loss.
